result.summary: Page is largely intact but shows 3 visual issues: an apparently missing icon in the top-right button, inconsistent favorite-button styling, and inconsistent image fill in the Fastest near you carousel.

issues.description: Top-right circular button appears empty - light grey circle with only a small red notification dot and no visible avatar, bell, or profile icon
issues.suggestion: Ensure the profile/notification icon or avatar image loads correctly; provide a default user or bell icon as fallback instead of blank placeholder

issues.description: Favorite heart button styling is inconsistent in Popular right now: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows plain white outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows heart inside a dark circular scrim
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite button treatment with dark scrim/background for contrast on all restaurant images

issues.description: Green Bowl Poke thumbnail in Fastest near you does not fill its card, leaving large empty light-grey area while neighboring Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria cards are full-bleed
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent object-fit cover and aspect ratio handling so all carousel images fully fill their cards
